run_kinematics: run forward kinematics to compute global positions and orientations for all bodies, sites, and geoms
run_rne: run inverse dynamics using the recursive Newton-Euler algorithm to compute bias forces and internal forces
run_crb: run composite rigid body inertia computation and joint-space inertia matrix factorization
run_tendon: run tendon length and moment computation for joint, site, and geom-based tendon wrap paths
run_solve_m: run backsubstitution on the factorized inertia matrix to solve the linear system x = M^{-1} y
